items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 20 June 2026 7:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 20 June 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry with sunny spells, but with a little patchy low cloud in some places, this clearing quickly. Light west or southwest wind, top temperature of 19°C.

Continuing fine and dry tomorrow with warm sunny spells and temperatures rising to 21 or 22°C in the afternoon.


##Outlook##

High pressure remaining dominant for much of the working week, bringing largely settled conditions.
